newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian '97 deficit seen at three pct - source.
newsitem.headline: Italian '97 deficit seen at three pct - source.

text.p: Italy's public administration deficit is expected to be three percent of gross domestic product (GDP) in 1997 thanks to the recently introduced mini-budget, a source at the Treasury said.

Earlier a Portuguese newspaper reported that European Commission forecasts would point to an Italian budget deficit of 3.8 percent this year. The Treasury source said this figure referred to state accounts before the mini-budget was presented.
The mini-budget, which included some 15.5 trillion lire of deficit cutting measures, was unveiled at the end of last month.
The government has pledged to reach the three percent target, as laid down by the Maastricht Treaty for countries wishing to sign up to the single European currency, by the end of the year.
The deficit/GDP ratio was 6.7 percent last year. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
